title: Latent Feedback Is a Compute and Data Amplifier
abstract: arXiv:2611.20404v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When high-quality data runs out, a common practice is to train on it for several epochs, but each repeat is worth less than the last. Latent feedback, which feeds each token's top-layer state into the next token's input, is another way to spend that compute, yet it has not been tested against a vanilla Transformer that spends the same compute on more epochs. We run this test across a ladder of model sizes, unique data and epochs, tuning both models at every size and amount of unique data. Latent feedback makes every FLOP and every token count for more except when unique data is scarce relative to model size, a regime that today's models are far from. We find that latent feedback serves as an amplifier: with unique data fixed, it reaches a Transformer's loss with less compute; with epochs fixed, it reaches that loss with less unique data. Furthermore, both savings grow with unique data per parameter and with repetition, and downstream tas

translated_title: 潜在反馈是计算与数据的放大器
translated_abstract: 当高质量数据耗尽时，一种常见的做法是在这些数据上进行多个epoch的训练，但每次重复的价值都低于前一次。潜在反馈是一种将每个token的顶层状态送入下一个token输入的机制，它是花费这些计算量的另一种方式，但此前尚未与把相同计算量用于更多epoch训练的普通Transformer进行过对比测试。我们在模型规模、唯一数据量和epoch数量的阶梯上开展了这一测试，并在每个规模和唯一数据量下对两种模型均进行了调优。结果显示，潜在反馈能让每个FLOP和每个token发挥更大价值，除非唯一数据相对于模型规模显得稀缺——而当今的模型远未进入这种状态。我们发现潜在反馈起到了放大器的作用：在唯一数据固定的情况下，它以更少的计算量达到普通Transformer的损失水平；在epoch固定的情况下，它以更少的唯一数据达到同样的损失水平。此外，这两种节省都随每参数唯一数据量和重复次数的增长而增大，在下游任务上（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 潜在反馈能同时放大计算与数据效率——在固定唯一数据量时以更少计算量、或在固定训练轮数时以更少数据量达到普通Transformer的损失水平，且节省幅度随每参数数据量和重复次数的增加而扩大。
en_tdlr: Latent feedback acts as a compute and data amplifier: with fixed unique data it matches a vanilla Transformer's loss using less compute, and with fixed epochs it matches that loss using less unique data, with savings growing as data per parameter and repetition increase.
